exposure: Middle Cerebral Artery Pulsatility Index (MCA PI)
cohort: The study included 296 nulliparous women with singleton postdated pregnancy admitted for Induction of Labour.
finding: The Middle Cerebral Artery Pulsatility Index (MCA PI) at a cut-off of <1.67 showed high sensitivity (100%), specificity (99.3%), and diagnostic accuracy (99.3%) for predicting successful labour induction.
mod_finding: Around 98.9% of women with successful IOL achieved a vaginal delivery.
